body.x: WiseJet Co., Ltd. has won a CES 2027 Innovation Award in the Construction & Industrial Tech category for its contactless wireless connector solution. The award winners were announced on November 9, 2026 (U.S. local time).

The award-winning product, the WC6 60GHz Contactless Wireless Connector Solution, is a wireless communication connector module commercialized using WiseJet's proprietary WC6 60GHz wireless communication technology. Its key feature is that it completely eliminates physical electrical contacts while delivering data transmission performance comparable to that of wired connections.

The currently available module operates at distances of less than 2 cm and supports a transmission speed of 10 Gbps per lane. Using a four-lane multi-lane configuration, it can transmit up to 40 Gbps of uncompressed data (4 lanes × 10 Gbps) with ultra-low latency of 7 ns or less.

One of the solution's key differentiators is its ability to fundamentally address mechanical wear and contact failure, longstanding issues associated with conventional physical connectors. The WC6-AiP-eDP, the first commercial wireless connector module specifically designed for display panel inspection lines, was developed to replace the pogo (POGO) pins traditionally required in existing inspection processes.

The product is the world's first commercialized solution supporting 10 Gbps per lane and implements multi-lane communication through WiseJet's proprietary beamforming technology. This enables high-speed transmission of uncompressed raw data between test panels and inspection equipment without image degradation. By reducing contact failures and repetitive mechanical wear associated with conventional pogo pins, the solution helps improve inspection process reliability and lower maintenance costs, according to the company.

Building on its CES Innovation Award win, WiseJet plans to expand the application of its WC6 technology beyond display inspection lines and into a broader range of industries. The company aims to extend its high-speed wireless communication technology to various applications requiring advanced data connectivity, including consumer electronics such as smartphones and smart TVs, next-generation XR devices, smart glasses, and robotics.

To support this expansion, WiseJet plans to demonstrate its technology at CES 2027 at Booth No. 26548 in the LVCC Central Hall. The company also intends to strengthen its global market presence through continued proofs of concept (PoCs) and technical validation with industry partners worldwide.

A WiseJet representative commented, "Innovation in next-generation advanced industries begins with the evolution of connectivity. Winning the CES 2027 Innovation Award is a meaningful recognition from the global market that WiseJet's 60GHz wireless technology can overcome the longstanding limitations of wired connectors, including mechanical wear and spatial constraints."
The representative added, "We will continue to transform the landscape of industries such as display manufacturing, robotics, and AI servers, leading the way toward a cable-free world."

Meanwhile, WiseJet is a fabless company specializing in the design of 60GHz millimeter-wave (mmWave) wireless communication semiconductor chips and modules. The company holds proprietary technologies in ultra-high-speed 10Gbps wireless transmission and beamforming, supported by 31 registered patents and eight patent applications.

body.x: For the past 21 years, global media outlet AVING NEWS has covered CES on the ground. To further expand the reach of innovation news in the AI era, AVING NEWS is operating a special CES 2027 news platform, AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news).

Having supported the global expansion of Korean startups through more than 1,000 news reports and hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS will once again provide extensive coverage of Korean innovators at CES 2027. At the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), the media outlet will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcasting zone, delivering the latest developments from Korean innovative companies to audiences around the world.

In addition, AVING NEWS will host the 3rd Innovation Award Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on November 25 (Wednesday) at 5 p.m. Separate video interviews will also be conducted with participating companies. Registration is available through Eventus.

In early December, AVING NEWS plans to launch its pre-CES coverage program, including international media interviews featuring invited U.S. media representatives who cover CES annually and serve as media judges for the CES Innovation Awards.
